title: runBenchmark
responsibility: Schedules reproducible trials, persists each outcome and attributes benchmark analytics to the source project.

inputs.name: runBenchmark.input
inputs.description: The request for one run: the benchmark definition file path (the definition's project must resolve to the Git repository root), the codex and claude runners, the repository that saves the run, and the AbortSignal that stops scheduling and interrupts the active trial. The optional seed defaults to randomUUID() when it is undefined or null and fixes the candidate order, and the optional onProgress callback is skipped when it is undefined.

inputs.name: benchmarkSchedule.run
inputs.description: Only run.seed, the ids in definition.candidates and definition.budget.repetitions (validated as an integer from 1 to 100) are read to build the schedule, so recorded trials and other fields do not change it.

definition.name: retry-backoff-fix
definition.task: Make the retry client wait the full jittered backoff before each resubmission.
definition.contract: Keep the public RetryClient API unchanged and edit only the allowed files.

outputs.name: runBenchmark
outputs.description: The run after the schedule loop, saved to the repository before it resolves, with completedAt set only when the signal was not aborted. Each trial keeps its final status (passed, failed, invalid, timeout, error or interrupted), and runner, setup and evaluation failures are recorded on that trial as its status and error instead of rejecting the promise.

definition.name: retry-backoff-fix
definition.task: Make the retry client wait the full jittered backoff before each resubmission.
definition.contract: Keep the public RetryClient API unchanged and edit only the allowed files.

outputs.name: benchmarkSchedule
outputs.description: Flat execution order of {candidate, repetition} entries: for each repetition from 1 to budget.repetitions, one entry per candidate, sorted by the SHA-256 fingerprint of [run.seed, entry].

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by prepareBenchmark when the file at path is not valid JSON, before the schema is checked.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate when the parsed definition fails the strict schema, for example an unknown key, a budget value outside its range, an invalid allowedFiles path, or a codex candidate that uses files tools or max effort.

errors.name: BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate duplicate identifier failure
errors.description: Thrown by BenchmarkDefinitionValidator.validate with message 'Duplicate benchmark identifiers or paths.' when the schema passes but allowedFiles, check ids or candidate ids contain a duplicate.

errors.name: benchmarkGit failure
errors.description: Thrown by benchmarkGit with message 'Benchmark Git operation failed. Verify the project and revision.' when a git command exits non-zero: the rev-parse calls and the ls-tree listing in prepareBenchmark, and the ls-tree listing and git archive in snapshotBenchmark.

errors.name: prepareBenchmark project-root failure
errors.description: Thrown by prepareBenchmark with message 'Benchmark project must be the Git repository root.' when the resolved project directory is not the realpath of the Git top-level directory.

errors.name: benchmarkFiles unsupported-entry failure
errors.description: Thrown by benchmarkFiles with message 'Benchmark snapshots do not support symlinks or submodules.' when a tree entry is not a regular 100644 or 100755 blob; prepareBenchmark and snapshotBenchmark both call it.

errors.name: CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight failure
errors.description: Thrown by CodexBenchmarkAdapter.preflight with message 'Codex runner is unavailable.' when codex --version exits non-zero; prepareBenchmark awaits it for each codex candidate, so no run is saved.

errors.name: ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.preflight failure
errors.description: Thrown by ClaudeBenchmarkAdapter.preflight with message 'Claude runner is unavailable.' when claude --version exits non-zero; prepareBenchmark awaits it for each claude candidate, so no run is saved.

errors.name: BoundedCommandFailure
errors.description: Rejected with BoundedCommandFailure through benchmarkProcess when a git, tar or runner --version child cannot start, hits its time limit, or writes more than the 8,000,000-byte output bound (message 'Command output limit exceeded.' in that case); prepareBenchmark and snapshotBenchmark do not catch it.

errors.name: snapshotBenchmark tar-extraction failure
errors.description: Thrown by snapshotBenchmark with message 'Could not extract benchmark snapshot.' when the tar extraction of the git archive exits non-zero.

errors.name: snapshotBenchmark missing-file failure
errors.description: Thrown by snapshotBenchmark with message 'Snapshot files are missing; export-ignore archives are unsupported.' when a file listed by benchmarkFiles is missing or not a regular file in the extracted baseline.

errors.name: Benchmark definition or workspace filesystem failure
errors.description: Node.js file-system error (for example with code ENOENT) from reading the definition, resolving the project, or creating and removing run directories; errors thrown by the supplied repository's directory or save methods also reject runBenchmark.
